description: Minimal fixture demonstrating a real TCE-filtered mutant, not just TCE's cost with nothing to show for it (see corpus/op-control-if, whose 8 mutants all survive TCE unfiltered). DeadStore assigns `total := 999` immediately before overwriting it with `total = 0`, a textbook dead-store-elimination case validated by a direct spike during TCE's own development. Run with tce=true: two literal/number shifts on the dead `999` (`999 -> 1000`, `999 -> 998`) compile identically to the original and are filtered as equivalent, dropping the mutant count from 7 (TCE off) to 5. The one not-viable mutant (statement/remover attempting to delete the `total := 999` declaration entirely) fails to compile in both modes -- a genuinely different failure class from TCE equivalence, caught before TCE ever runs.
